prior_continuity_gap.prior_matrix: Eight raw UI PASS/24 pixel pairs qualified, original settings restored.
prior_continuity_gap.gap: Literal same_app_lifetime=true was not an independent PID measurement; activate can launch if process has exited. No evidence that any restart occurred either.
prior_continuity_gap.resolution: Use PID in first line of public XCUIApplication.debugDescription, fail on unknown format, require same PID in all three foreground/surface-qualified phases. No private processID/KVC API. Repeat affected matrix at new test-only checkpoint; keep prior results at original scope.

installation_scope: Five OS-only groups preserve installed_app_verified=false; actual test runner/Settings identity verified. Functional groups explicitly install and byteverify own App before/after. No historical OS-only field relabelled.
instrumentation_limits: Initial full-root per-node queries took roughly70s phone/240s pad. Requested executionTimeAllowance120 was not wall-enforced: xctestrun TestTimeoutsEnabled=false. No hard-timeout claim.
